source.title: An analysis of the Big Gaps found in the Liber Primus
source.author: CurtbroG

sampling: Two pages from the source's 16-page big-gap list, its named LP2-57 parable exception, and one page from its 15-page comparison list. The four pages were fixed before measuring and are not a random or exhaustive sample.
segmentation: On each original 2400x3600 JPEG, a horizontal pixel row is active when at least five pixels inside the fixed x-range have grayscale value below the threshold. Merge active rows across at most 14 wholly inactive rows. Report each inclusive ink-row interval and the count of blank rows between adjacent intervals.
exclusions: Original source screenshots do not preserve exact coordinates. The selected image regions and count rule are ours; this is a check of observed gap sizes, not a reconstruction of the author's Canva selections or a whole-book punctuation census.
